sha256_note: text files (.csv, .json, .py) are hashed with CRLF read as LF; model_version is the first 12 hex characters of the Pipeline artefact's SHA-256, as the API reports it
legacy_equivalence: results/historical/refit_equivalence.json: parameters identical to the original two-file artefact
checks_passed: seeded split (seed, test_size from metrics.json) reproduces test_predictions.csv row for row
saved model reproduces all 2,000 saved held-out predictions
recomputed accuracy and confusion matrix equal results/historical/metrics.json
figure 08 components sum to the model's decision score (absolute difference 3.2e-14)

06_probe_outputs.note: hand-written probes; expected = the sentiment each was written to express
06_probe_outputs.narrow_layout: 06_probe_outputs_narrow_{light,dark}.png: the same data, 360 CSS px wide at 3x, for README columns on viewports below 960 px

07_error_by_length.binning: quartiles of whitespace word count over all 2,000 held-out reviews (pandas.qcut, both classes pooled)
07_error_by_length.interval: 95% Wilson score interval per cell; treats reviews as independent
07_error_by_length.narrow_layout: 07_error_by_length_narrow_{light,dark}.png: the same data, 360 CSS px wide at 3x, for README columns on viewports below 960 px

08_score_contributions.method: contribution = SVM weight x TF-IDF value; plus intercept; terms beyond the largest 8 summed as other terms
